description: ZP-MC-CC-F10A-14G is the drawing identifier for connector contact component in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector contact component provides part of the electrical mating interface inside a selected connector assembly. Its drawing is not a complete housing or cable-entry arrangement.

For example, in a machine connection pack specifying contacts separately from the connector shell, use the ZP-MC-CC-F10A-14G reference to coordinate contact-to-insert interface and conductor termination approach. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC-CC-F10A-14G.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep contact-to-insert interface and conductor termination approach visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named ZP-MC-CC-F10A-14G drawing and its connector contact component role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
